tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew ʾadam, 'man, human', related to ʾadamah, 'ground, earth'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-d-m. Adam, the first man (Genesis 2). Adam is a Hebrew name meaning “Man; human being; (also) earth, red”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
